SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Route Patrol Station,
No. I. C. D. 843.
Date January 4, 1930.）

Subject (in full) Comrade Krusky.

Made by D.S. Nekrasov'y. Forwarded by Tho Rubenstein S.D.I

Information has been received to the effect that
Comrade Krusky, Russian Jew, who arrived in Shanghai
from Moscow via Harbin in March 1929, is a rabid
Communist. He is a graduate of the Special Communistic
Propaganda School in Moscow and since his arrival in
Shanghai has disseminated verbal communistic propaganda
amongst local Jewish youngsters. In his conversation
he is very anti-British and is employed as a porter,
by the American Welsh Transportation Coy and resides
on the premises at 56, Wayside Road.

B. Maklaenky.
D. S.

（批：HP 4/1）
（批：L.C.(Pol) authorities

表格第2号
G. 9040-8-29

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
巡捕房，
编号 I. C. D. 843。
日期：1930年1月4日。）

事由（全称）克鲁斯基同志。

呈报人：D.S. 涅克拉索夫'y。经由 S.D.I 托·鲁宾斯坦转呈

接获情报称，
克鲁斯基同志，俄籍犹太人，于1929年3月经哈尔滨从莫斯科抵达上海，是一名狂热的共产主义者。他毕业于莫斯科特别共产主义宣传学校，自抵沪以来，一直在当地犹太青年中散布口头共产主义宣传。他在谈话中表现出强烈的反英倾向，受雇于美国威尔士运输公司（American Welsh Transportation Coy）担任搬运工，居住在韦赛德路56号院内。

B. 马克莱恩基。
D. S.

（批注：HP 1月4日）
